assets.name: American Express Co.
assets.notes: TTM to Sep-2026. Card issuer AND network that lends to card members, so it is valued like a lender: cash flow = NET INCOME ($11.4B, stock pay already deducted), revenue = total revenues net of interest expense ($72.9B), and debt/interest are treated as part of the business (net cash set to zero, no interest add-back). Analysts expect ~9% revenue growth. Risks: consumer credit losses in a downturn and competition for premium cardholders.
assets.required_return_reason: Premium card issuer and network: durable brand, but it lends, so credit losses rise in recessions.

assets.name: Shopify Inc.
assets.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. E-commerce platform with integrated payments (Shopify Payments). Revenue +30% TTM; analysts expect ~26% next year. SBC-adjusted FCF margin ~14% today; the base case assumes it rises to 19% with scale. Very high expectations in the price (forward P/E ~63, beta ~2.6): 11% required return and 35% safety margin. $4.8B net cash.
assets.required_return_reason: Fast-growing commerce platform priced for continued high growth; very volatile shares (beta ~2.6).

assets.name: PayPal Holdings Inc.
assets.notes: TTM to Sep-2026. Digital wallet and online checkout (PayPal, Venmo, Braintree). Slow growth (~4% expected) but cheap (forward P/E ~10) with heavy buybacks. SBC-adjusted cash margin ~16%. Net debt $3.2B (customer balances excluded). Risks: losing branded-checkout share to Apple Pay and others; the bear case has sales shrinking 4% and margins down to 11% (the price implies roughly that).
assets.required_return_reason: Large digital wallet with slowing growth and competition at checkout from Apple Pay and others.

assets.name: Block Inc.
assets.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. Valued on GROSS PROFIT (~$11.5B TTM, ESTIMATE from 2025 GP and 2026 guidance), not revenue: ~$9-10B of reported revenue is low-margin bitcoin sales passed through Cash App. 2026 guidance raised: gross profit $12.51B (+21%), adjusted operating income $3.47B (28% margin). Cash App GP +31%, Square GP +13% in Q2. Stock pay is heavy (~10% of gross profit). Net cash $5.1B. High beta (~2.5): 11% required return, 35% safety margin.
assets.required_return_reason: Two growing ecosystems (Cash App, Square) but high volatility, heavy stock pay and consumer-credit exposure.

assets.name: Adyen N.V. (ADR)
assets.notes: Per US ADR (ADYEY; 100 ADRs = 1 Amsterdam share; shares = ADR equivalents). Reports in EUR, converted at 1.117 USD/EUR (27 Oct 2026). TTM to Jun-2026 net revenue ~EUR 2.86B (2025 EUR 2.65B + H1-26 EUR 1.30B, +19%); EBITDA margin 49%; capex ~7% of revenue in 2026. FCF is an ESTIMATE (~36% of net revenue: net income + depreciation - capex), because reported cash flow swings with merchant settlement funds. Its large cash balance is mostly merchants' money, so net cash is set to zero (conservative). 2026 guidance: net revenue +21-23% (constant currency); EBITDA margin >55% by 2028. FX moves the USD value.
assets.required_return_reason: High-quality global acquirer with net cash, but growth swings with large merchants; euro-reported (FX risk for USD holders).

assets.name: Fiserv Inc.

Very cheap (P/E ~6) but carries $27.8B net debt, so equity value is very sensitive to the business value: 35% safety margin.
assets.required_return_reason: Sticky bank-technology franchise, but heavy debt and a recent guidance reset.

assets.name: Circle Internet Group
assets.notes: TTM to Jun-2026. Issuer of the USDC stablecoin: earns interest on the reserves backing USDC (Q2-26 reserve income $668M, +5%) and pays ~59% of revenue to distributors (mainly Coinbase). assets.required_return_reason: Young public company; income depends on interest rates, USDC adoption and crypto regulation.
